
Pre 469 build:

Per-device PIA WireGuard VPNs for ASUS routers, managed from your phone. Tap a device, pick a VPN, done. Self-healing watchdog renews expired configs and emails you. Standalone .conf generation for any WireGuard client. Zero credential persistence, open source, GPL v3.

Build 469:

Android app for per-device PIA WireGuard VPNs on ASUS routers. Tap a device, pick a VPN, done. A self-healing watchdog on the router replaces dead configurations and emails you. Also generates PIA conf files for any WireGuard client. GPL v3.

---
Build 474:

Android privacy and security app for ASUS routers, with PIA WireGuard VPNs. Pin each device to a VPN; on stock firmware a kill switch keeps it off the internet if its tunnel drops. A self-healing watchdog on the router rebuilds dead configs and emails you. Also generates PIA conf files for any WireGuard client. GPL v3.
